What the question asks for is the “east-west railway trunk lines” for outward coal transport, so only the railway corridors in the figure that run nearly east-west and transport coal out of the province are read, and north-south lines or intra-provincial branch lines are not included in the ordering. Reasoning: Looking from north to south according to the map position, the northernmost east-west outward-transport trunk line corresponds to the Daqin Line; an east-west outward-transport trunk line to its south corresponds to the Shenhuang Line; farther south, the east-west corridor is the corridor in which the Shitai Line connects eastward to the Shide Line, and then connects with the Jinghu Line and the Jiaoji Line. Therefore, from north to south, they are: Daqin Line, Shenhuang Line, Shitai—Shide—Jinghu—Jiaoji Line.
